title: Autonomous research assistant for literature review
description:
Build an agent that takes a research question, searches multiple sources, and returns a synthesised answer with citations.

The agent should decide on its own how many sources to consult and must clearly attribute every claim it makes. Teams are free to use any LLM provider.

Expected output: a working demo, the source repository, and a short walkthrough of how the agent plans its search.

title: Multi-agent customer support triage
description:
Design a set of cooperating agents that classify incoming support tickets, route them to the right queue, and draft a first reply for a human to approve.

The system should handle at least four ticket categories and explain why it routed each ticket the way it did.

title: Meeting notes to action items
description:
Given a raw meeting transcript, produce a structured list of decisions, action items, and owners.

The solution must handle transcripts where speakers are not labelled, and should flag items where the owner is ambiguous rather than guessing.
